use_case: Video analytics for building access: tailgating detection that counts people passing each turnstile lane against badge reads and alerts the SCC with a clip
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (computer-vision person-detection model)
build_or_buy: Buy (platform feature, enabled by the vendor)
data_categories: Video of turnstile lanes at Towers 1-4; turnstile badge events; alert clips (no face templates; no identity inferred)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (advisory alerts); re-tier to Safety/CI if alerts drive automatic turnstile or door actions
human_in_the_loop: SCC operator reviews the clip and badge record before any action; the only permitted action is a courteous badge check; no refusal of entry or report to a tenant based on an alert alone
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) and the FTC biometric policy statement (2023-05-18); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (video is excluded from biometric data under 501.702); Fla. Stat. 934.03 (audio stays disabled); CISA CPG 2.0 3.P (voluntary)
status: In production (Towers 1-4 since 2025-11); approved with conditions due 2026-11-30

use_case: Video analytics for building access: face verification that compares a live capture at 2 Tower 2 turnstile lanes with the enrolled badge photo and denies entry on a mismatch (pilot for one anchor tenant)
vendor_or_model: Access control and video platform vendor (face recognition model)
data_categories: Face templates from badge photos and live captures for about 240 enrolled tenant employees (treated as biometric data)
consequential_decision_category: Safety/CI (entry to a workplace in a critical infrastructure facility)
human_in_the_loop: Officer at the lobby desk can override a rejection; the system denies entry first
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 and the FTC biometric policy statement; Fla. Stat. 501.171 (treated as biometric personal information; whether templates computed from camera video fall within the 501.702 exclusion for data generated from video is unsettled, counsel to confirm)
status: Pilot since 2026-04; suspended 2026-09-30 by COO decision; templates to be deleted by 2026-10-31

use_case: License plate recognition at 6 garages: plate reads for permit enforcement; exports shared with company security for investigations
business_owner: Director of Security Operations (data sharing); parking operator (system)
vendor_or_model: Parking operator (optical character recognition model in its revenue control system)
data_categories: Plate numbers, images, times, and garage; linked to names for about 3,100 monthly permit holders
consequential_decision_category: None directly; investigative use could affect individuals
human_in_the_loop: Security investigators review every export; no automated alerts on tenants or visitors
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5; Fla. Stat. 501.171 (plate reads linked to names may be geolocation information, counsel to confirm)
status: In use (operator system); sharing approved with conditions due 2027-01-31

use_case: BAS energy optimization: a cloud machine learning service that writes supervisory setpoints (chilled water supply temperature, air handler discharge temperature, duct static pressure) to Platform A at Towers 1-2
vendor_or_model: Energy optimization vendor (machine learning model, vendor-hosted) through a connector in the workloads account
data_categories: BAS trend data; setpoint writes (no personal information)
human_in_the_loop: Chief engineers can disable writes at any time; field controllers enforce equipment safety limits; company-enforced write limits required as a condition
applicable_laws: CISA CPG 2.0 1.D, 3.I (voluntary); NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (OT guidance); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor savings claims)
status: In production (Towers 1-2 since 2025-10); approved with conditions; expansion to Towers 3-4 paused

use_case: Generative AI lease abstraction: drafts lease abstracts (critical dates, options, obligations) from signed leases for the lease administration team
vendor_or_model: Generative AI SaaS (large language model) on a business subscription
data_categories: Leases and amendments (Confidential); tenant contact names in notice clauses
human_in_the_loop: Lease administrator verifies every critical date, option, and notice term against the lease before entry in the property management system
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (vendor data use claims); contract confidentiality terms in leases
status: In use (Legal since 2026-05); approved with conditions due 2026-11-30
